Iowa Grain Elevators and Services
Your Local Experts in Grain Procurement & Storage
Five Star Cooperative operates grain elevators at 15 locations across North Iowa, with 30 million bushels of storage for corn and soybeans, plus grain buying, drying, on-farm pickup and contracting. Five Star Cooperative helps you to streamline your grain transactions by offering reliable grain storage, competitive cash bids, and flexible contracting options at our conveniently located elevators. We have been empowering farmers to achieve their goals since 1889.

Five Star holds the harvest longer
Having enough storage space to hold grain until the market calls for it is advantageous in the grain business to cooperative members.
As a part of our commitment to our members we continually reinvest into our facilities to offer more space and improved services.
Recent investments include additional storage space, RFID readers at several locations, message boards and lights, improved grain dumps, and more.

Our grain elevator services
Five Star Cooperative operates grain elevators as part of its wide range of services including:

A variety of options for contracting or spot sales.
Grain Storage
With a total storage capacity of 30 million bushels across all locations.
Grain Drying
Haul grain directly from the field with competitive drying rates.
On-farm Pickup
Competitive transportation rates.
Grain elevator services
Helping you move grain quickly while protecting your bottom line
Marketing Options That Fit Your Farm
We know grain marketing and storage can make or break your bottom line. That’s why Five Star Cooperative offers cash bids, forward contracts, hedging options, and storage—all backed by a grain team that works with you to build selling plans that fit your operation’s goals.
Convenient Technology and Access
Our facilities are built for speed and convenience. Many locations use RFID tag readers and external ticket printers, so you can haul grain without ever leaving the cab. Scale tickets are always at your fingertips through the Five Star Link Customer Portal, making it easy to track information whenever you need it.
Fast, Reliable Service
With a wide network of buyers, fast turnaround times, and dependable local support, we help you move grain quickly, reduce risk, and keep your operation running smoothly.
Grain Storage Options
We offer contracting, paid storage, and occasionally no fee price later so you can hold onto your crop and market it later, when prices may be stronger. These flexible options give you more control and marketing freedom.
Transportation Services
We provide transportation support and work to negotiate favorable costs, making it easier and more affordable to move your grain when and where it’s needed.
Quality Control Standards
Your grain is protected with around-the-clock monitoring. Our technology tracks bins and storage facilities 24/7, keeping quality high and meeting market requirements. Whether you’re using grain bank or traditional storage, you can count on us to keep your grain in top shape until you’re ready to sell.
Selling grain to Five Star
Cash bids & futures

Grain policies
Cash bids & futures
A cash bid is the current set price offered for a specific delivery period. This means a farmer can sell their grain today at the price offered by the buyer and reflect the local market conditions. Cash bids are straightforward and easy to understand, making them a popular option for farmers who prefer straight forward sales and less complexity.
Futures are agreements or contracts to buy or sell a specific quantity of grain at a predetermined price and date in the future. These contracts are standardized and traded on exchanges like the Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT).
View bids & futures chart
Enter grain offer
Customers can access cash bids and futures information through the Five Star Link Customer Portal or sign up for twice daily bid text messages.
Grain contracts
Grain contracts are legal agreements between farmers and buyers that set the terms for selling and delivering grain. They help manage price risk, reduce uncertainty, and make transactions smoother. With a contract, you can “lock in” a price months ahead of delivery—giving you more control over your bottom line.
Five Star Cooperative offers a variety of grain contracts to fit your operation, including the options below:
Offer Contract
Hedge-to-Arrive (HTA) Contract
Priced Contract
Basis Contract
Minimum-Priced Contract
Accumulator Contract
Deferred Payment Contract
Price Later Contract
Speciality Contract (Premium Offer, Min/Max, etc)
Learn about grain contracts
Choosing the right grain contract
Grain procurement policies
Grain procurement policies are a set of guidelines and procedures that provide clear and transparent grain outlines of the terms and conditions for buying grain helping farmers reduce uncertainty.
Five Star Cooperative’s well-defined grain procurement policies benefit grain farmers by providing transparency, fairness, efficiency, and risk management tools in the grain marketing process.
View procurement policies
Frequently Asked Questions
What crops do you handle?
Corn and soybeans.
How much storage do you have?
30 million bushels across 15 locations.
What grain contracts do you offer?
Offer, Hedge-to-Arrive, Priced, Basis, Minimum-Priced, Accumulator, Deferred Payment, Price Later and specialty contracts.
Can I haul without leaving the cab?
Many locations have RFID tag readers and external ticket printers, and scale tickets are in Five Star Link.
